## Highlights
### Fixed
- Screen sharing works in Slack huddles and in Slack's call test on pages that run in Chromium. As in Chrome, a site can ask to share your screen without a click of its own, and macOS still asks what to share.
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.
